subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with explicit account-level nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, the two prior unmerged PRs show a design fork, and either implementation expands Slack config/API surface that AGENTS.md treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Implement validated nativeNames
options.body: Add one explicit per-account mapping surface with duplicate/format validation, registration and reverse lookup support, arg-menu roundtrip coverage, docs, and schema tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting a simpler UX but a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document unsupported duplicate names
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement validated nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add one explicit per-account mapping surface with duplicate/format validation, registration and reverse lookup support, arg-menu roundtrip coverage, docs, and schema tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for shared command registry and Slack native command documentation/routing points to steipete.
